description: Validate local manifest text in-memory before deploy (pass id + content, 120/min limit, no network fetch, always available) or audit a public origin across 12 syntax-validated manifests and 37 protocol probe rules when live probing is active (7d KV report cache; fresh: true re-probes live with 5-min cooldown, 30/min limit; see /status/). Returns { valid, errors, warnings, repaired_content } for single-file content checks, or { conformance_summary, agent_routing, connect_recipe, permissions, manifests } for origin audits; combine verify: true (live MCP/A2A handshakes), bridge: true (ARD/AI Catalog cross-manifest check), diff: true (manifest drift vs the previous KV cached report, or none when no snapshot is stored), or brief/compact payload trimming. Use validate_manifest for spec conformance and local linting; use probe for raw discovery or template to generate starter files.

bridge.description: true: fetch and validate each entry inside /.well-known/ard.json or ai-catalog.json against its target spec and check cross-manifest coherence

brief.description: true: return concise routing, callable endpoints, and permissions only

compact.description: true: omit nested probe packet and absent manifests

content.description: raw local JSON, Markdown, or text content to validate in-memory without network fetches

content_type.description: optional Content-Type header when validating local content

diff.description: true: compare the current report against the previous KV cached report, or none when no snapshot is stored (manifests_added/removed/changed, new_errors)

fresh.description: true: bypass the 7d KV report cache and re-probe live (5-minute per-origin cooldown)

id.description: manifest id or filename (ard, ai-catalog-well-known-file, mcp-server-cards, a2a, llms-txt, agents-md, anthropic-agent-skills-format, api-catalog-rfc9727, ai-crawler-tokens-robots, security-txt, auth-md, okf)

origin.description: [TEMPORARILY PAUSED — pass id + content for offline validation instead] public hostname to fetch (optional when passing content + id for local pre-commit validation)

verify.description: true: actively handshake declared MCP and A2A endpoints and verify liveness

name: validate_manifest
title: Validate an origin's or local file's manifests
